Name: Furry Stardew Valley Expanded Continued
Author: RydelTheOtter
Description:
A conversion to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] fit with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]. An unofficial update to both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5074]SVE Furry Conversion Patch[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6466879]Lycanglass[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15614]SDVE Unique Furry Sprites[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52800236]BrightonMorris1[/url]

As of 1.1.0, you can also select to use the original portraits for Martin, Olivia, Susan, Victor in the config.json file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b]Installation:
[/b]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20873]Anthro Characters 1.5 for Stardew Valley 1.6[/url] and all prerequisites
4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and all prerequisites
5. Install this mod by extracting it to your mods folder

[b]Credits:[/b]
Sprites from Stardew Valley Expananded by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] Poltergeister, and HopeWasHere
Sprites from Anthro Characters Continued by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2417747]Sion9000[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/gaveliere.616423/]Gaveliere[/url]
Andy Sprites by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/75563703-lycanthropire/]Lycanthropire[/url]
Claire, ﻿Axel, Brooklyn, Chloe, Jace, and Zoey sprites by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/4905383-karuaterrosa/]KeruAterrosa[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15614?tab=description]SDVE Unique Furry Sprites[/url] (Olivia, Victor, Susan, Suki, Scarlett, Martin, and updates to Lance) by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52800236]BrightonMorris1
[/url]Based on and using sprites from the previous ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5074?tab=description]SVE - Furry Conversion Patch[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6466879]Lycanglass
[/url]Contains sprite updates by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3746330]RTgrl[/url]

Fixed overworld sprite issues with Highlands Dwarf
Fixed buyable portraits of characters showing them as human
Fixed Claire and Martin appearing human in some cutscenes
